modalLead: Closing a modal in the config view closed the config view with it. Opening the add-bookmark form from settings and pressing Escape dismissed both, landing you on the dashboard instead of back on the section you were reading.

items.text: Esc closes one layer at a time — every full-container view registers a global Esc handler that closes it, and a modal does not stop the key from travelling onward, so both handlers legitimately saw the same press: the modal closed itself and the view closed underneath it. Health and inbox already guarded against this; config did not, despite a comment claiming it matched them. It now dismisses whatever is on top and only closes the view once nothing is above it — covering the tag cloud, an active search and inline editing as well.
